description:
Switch response.json to JSONL of §4.4 stream events; the harness
writes events line-by-line during the model call; closing the
write fd is the completion signal (inotify IN_CLOSE_WRITE).

=== Scope ===

1. Adapter integration. lernie-provider-anthropic already supports
   streaming per §4.4 (advertised in describe.capabilities,
   implemented in adapter/streaming.rs). The harness's run_exchange
   path calls 'complete' with stream:true and reads the JSONL
   event stream from the adapter's stdout.

2. response.json write path. As each event arrives on the
   adapter's stdout, the harness writes it as a single JSONL line
   to <conv-repo>/steps/<conv-id>/<NNN>/response.json. File is
   created at step start; closed (write fd dropped) at terminal
   message_stop or terminal error event.

3. Single shape on disk regardless of streaming-vs-non-streaming
   adapter mode. Non-streaming collapses to a one-event-then-stop
   sequence on disk. Per amended §4.4 (in P1), the wire-side mode
   distinction does not propagate to the on-disk shape.

4. In-memory messages assembly: the harness still parses the JSONL
   events into a normalized response shape (assistant text +
   tool_use blocks) for the next step's wire request. This is the
   in-memory side; response.json on disk is never read back.

5. lernie prompt --stream flag is NOT introduced — streaming is
   always-on per the new contract. (If a downstream caller needs
   non-streaming for some legacy path, file a follow-up; not in
   v0.3.1 scope.)

=== Constraints ===

- response.json remains diagnostic-only on the harness side. P3
  does not reintroduce a read site.
- Adapter cancellation (SIGTERM, §4.4) still flushes a terminal
  event before exit; harness writes that event before closing the
  fd, so the closed-fd signal always coincides with a terminal
  marker on disk.

=== Gates ===

Tests, docs, alignment per AGENTS.md.
title: v0.3.1 P3: response.json as JSONL stream + writer-closes-fd completion
